home.title: Dashboard
home.intro: Every backend service runs on its own port behind the edge; the web app talks to all of them through /api.

landing.title: Home
landing.tagline: A simple skeleton for a web app on Rust microservices and Vue.

what.title: What it is
what.text: A minimal starting point, not a finished product. A few small Rust services run behind one entry point, a Vue web app talks to them through /api, and each service keeps its data in SQLite. There is no business logic here: only the structure, the design and the tooling to build on.

inside.title: What is inside
items: edge: the single public entry point that proxies /api and serves the web app
core: shared configuration, database, migrations, errors and health checks
notes: a small example service with its own web module, tests and table
Liquid glass design with light and dark themes, in Russian and English
Feature modules on both sides: add a folder and it is picked up automatically
